name: El Misti volcano
region: Salinas y Aguada Blanca National Reserve, Arequipa
why: Arequipa's volcano: a walk-up to 5,822 m, an iron cross on the crater rim and the white city 3,500 m below.
book: Go with a licensed Arequipa agency (two days, transport to the trailhead). Crossing the Aguada Blanca dam needs a permit. Acclimatise several days at altitude first.
water: No water on the mountain: carry 4-5 litres for two days.
dangers: Altitude: above 5,000 m headache and nausea are common; go down if they get worse.
Very cold at camp and on the night start to the summit.
Loose scree and ash; volcanic gases near the crater.
turnaround: Not at the crater rim by 09:00, or any sign of altitude sickness: turn back.

points.name: Aguada Blanca trailhead
points.note: Where the track leaves the Aguada Blanca power station road, north of the volcano. Day 1 climbs the north flank.

points.name: Monte Blanco camp
points.note: The north base camp at about 4,600-4,800 m. Very cold; you leave around 01:00-02:00 for the summit.

points.name: Misti summit cross
points.note: 5,822 m, an iron cross on the north-west crater rim, over the crater and Arequipa. Back to camp, then down.
